_about: Entity node groups that name ONE object of the description, decided on 10-10 by reading each description against the qwen3.7-plus-v84 plan (scripts/dedupe_plans.py carries a merge out only when the dropped node's question words are all asked by the kept node or its children). Groups found with identical entity questions, or a coverage-pass suffix (_entity, _bg, _desc, _present, _2) next to a same-class sibling, and judged one object; pairs judged two objects (seat_left/seat_right, owner/mother, two nails, two chimneys, pilot's and traveler's suitcases, the woman's glasses and the pair on the table, ...) are not listed.
